Isack Hadjar to remain Red Bull F1 teammate in 2027

French driver Isack Hadjar will continue as teammate to Max Verstappen at Red Bull in the 2027 Formula One season. The 21-year-old joined the team this year. Red Bull confirmed the decision on Wednesday.
